title: Parent-Child EF Intervention
official: In-Home Parent-Child Training System: Validation Study
summary: Koronis Biomedical Technologies Corporation (KBT) is developing a cognitive intervention to promote healthy development of Executive Function (EF) skills in young children by leveraging a smartphone-based training regime designed for parents.
conditions: Cognitive Intervention to Promote Healthy Development of Executive Function (EF) Skills in Young Children
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children ages 2-5 years.
* Caregivers/guardian of the participating child.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children with physical disabilities affecting vision, hearing, or basic mobility.
* Children with severe developmental delays or disorders
* Parents or caregivers who cannot read and understand English

sites.f: University of Minnesota, Institute of Child Development
